INTRODUCTION

Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara), also known as Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva... He is great compassion, universally cures illness and suffering in the human world, and possesses immeasurable wisdom and supernatural powers. From countless previous lives, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva had already become a Buddha, with the title "Truth Dharma Insight Tathagata". Because of his fervent thoughts of saving sentient beings and his considerate heart to save suffering, He turned the compassionate ship back to the earthly world, incarnating Bodhisattva, along with Manjushri Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, known as the Four Great Bodhisattvas. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva did not leave the Western Pure Land, but together with Amitābha Buddha and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva formed the "Western Three Saints". At the same time, He also transformed into thousands of billions of millions of incarnations, appearing throughout the ten directions, countless Buddha lands, manifesting his physical body to save sentient beings.

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has extremely profound karma with sentient beings in the Saha world. He silently saves suffering, every wish is fulfilled, no wish is unfulfilled. The legends of spiritual inspiration from the past are countless and cannot be recorded all, so there is a saying that "Amitābha Buddha's house, Avalokiteśvara's house". Over thousands of years, Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara has reincarnated countless times. In the "Wonderful Dharma Lotus Sutra", the Buddha taught that: Whatever body sentient beings need to use to attain salvation, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva immediately appears in that body to preach the Dharma. In Chinese history, those who were proclaimed to be the reincarnation of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva included Liu Tat Ha (刘萨诃) during the Eastern Jin Dynasty, the Great Monk Bao Zhi Gong (宝志公) during the Southern Qi Liang Dynasty, the Great Monks of the Tang Dynasty... They were all not afraid to show off their powers and show miracles.

In the 21st century today, there is also a great person who is known to practice Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara's compassionate vow to save people. That is the Chief of Oriental Radio in Sydney, Australia - Mr. Lu Quan Hoang. Dai Lu possesses heavenly eyesight, can rely on the year of birth, zodiac animal and gender provided by the person, not separated by space and time, to observe the position, shape, and color of the "totem", thereby understanding the person's past and present lives, as well as the cause and effect of retribution. Through this method, He helps people clearly understand the truth of cause and effect and retribution like shadow and form, thereby "do not do evil, do good", leading people to believe in Buddha, recite sutras, cultivate the mind and practice. This not only changes your own destiny but also improves society, purifies humanity's living space, and lays a solid foundation to escape the ocean of suffering in the six realms of samsara.

The "Spiritual Dharma Gate" is a powerful Dharma method suitable for the basic needs of modern sentient beings, transmitted by Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva to sentient beings today; This method belongs to Mahayana Buddhism. Radio director Lu Quan Hoanh, through radio and the internet, has tried his best to propagate the Spiritual Dharma, for thirty years like a day, saving people without charging a penny. On Dai Dai Lu's body, the spirit of salvation, saving humanity, "unconditioned great kindness, great compassion" of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva is deeply depicted.

“Spiritual Dharma” advocates three great Dharma treasures: Reciting Sutras, Making Vows and Releasing Life, helping people to save themselves and save others, to be self-aware and to enlighten others (to help others be enlightened), thereby escaping pain and illness, resolving conflicts and obstacles, and improving wisdom and character. Thanks to its miraculous effectiveness and quick effectiveness, in just five short years, this method has penetrated deeply into people's hearts and has tens of millions of followers worldwide.

《Buddhist Journey to Heaven and Earth》 is one of the books in a series of publications compiled by the Dong Phuong Radio Secretariat. The book mainly collects the sights and ears of a Buddhist during his journey to visit the Holy Spiritual Pure Land in heaven, as well as scenes in hells and Hades. Many things witnessed, along with the cases heard on trial at the King's Palace, can even be compared to real incidents in real life, making the reader deeply shaken and awakened. Thereby, it warns the worldly people to be careful in their words and actions, like walking on thin ice, absolutely not to let loose or play with life; It is necessary to preserve the precepts, follow the medical teachings, and sincerely repent, only then can you avoid the retribution of hell and be reborn in the Spiritual Pure Land in the future. I pray that this book can help sentient beings who are lost in the five desires and six senses to soon wake up and learn to fear cause and effect.

Pray that more and more predestined sentient beings can board the salvation boat of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva: Purify the soul, leave suffering and be happy, transcend afflictions, eliminate karma, transcend predestined relationships, pay off all unjust debts, save sentient beings, ascend to Ultimate Bliss, strive to achieve the Four Saints.

I, Sacred Realm of the Spiritual Pure Land (1)
一、心灵净土圣境（一）

Question: Fellow Practitioners Share about the Spiritual Pure World.

On October 21, 2018, after I worshiped Buddha and recited sutras at Guanyin Hall, I saw the painting of mountains and water behind the Buddha altar so lifelike, the mountains and rivers seemed to appear clearly before my eyes, and my whole body felt as light as flying.

Spiritual Pure World :

Looking down from above, this world is surrounded by mountains, palaces and cascading buildings inside, the ancient architectural style is somewhat similar to the Ming Dynasty, inside are interspersed with modern architectural style buildings (somewhat similar to today's universities), all the buildings here are luminescent and sparkling, with seven rainbow colors, a bit similar to the holy scene of the Western World of Ultimate Bliss that I have seen on video, but it seems that it is not the World. Western Bliss.

There is a very large open square, the entire foundation and railings are made of white jade, on the foundation there is a very large circular pavilion, on the edge of the roof of the pavilion there are rattles hanging, following the blowing breeze, emitting waves of soft sounds. Listening more closely, it is the sound of reciting Buddha's name coming from each wave, momentarily changing into Master's Dharma sounds. The sound of Buddha's name and Master's Dharma sound continued to be transmitted one after another. There are Bodhisattvas who softly chant the Buddha's name, and occasionally chant the Master's Buddha's Word. The entire environment and atmosphere here are extremely pure, the spiritual realm is in a state of emptiness and silence, all the afflictions of the world cannot be disturbed.

This is the Spiritual Pure Land. People who practice the Spiritual Dharma Gate of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva will later be brought here to recite Buddha's name, chant Sutras, and listen to the Dharma. Seen from the air, the pure land is truly extremely vast. In the lake not far away, there were Bodhisattvas walking around. Inside the lake, there were more than a dozen lotus flowers blooming, some of them had bloomed as big as wheels. These flowers were for the Bodhisattvas in the human world who practiced extremely diligently and worked hard to make merit. Even though they were still in the human world and had not yet entered Nirvana, in the sky there were lotus flowers as big as wheels. There are lotus flowers that have bloomed, there are lotus flowers that are still blooming, with different colors. Looking a little closer, there is the scent of lotus flowers blowing, the fragrance is so pleasant that it cannot be described with worldly words.

Bodhisattvas sometimes recite Buddha's name and sometimes contemplate the Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss. As long as any Bodhisattva is a little distracted and not focused on reciting the Buddha's name, there will be a sound in the air and the Bodhisattvas will enter concentration and bow their heads to chant. In the upper floors, there were Bodhisattvas teaching the Dharma to the Students. The Students clasped their hands and worshiped the Bodhisattva. Every day in the Pure Land there will be mandala flowers falling, filling the air with fragrance. Bodhisattvas recite Buddha's name, chant sutras, and listen to the Dharma in each of those fragrant scents.

Here, all Bodhisattvas have enough supernatural powers, there are lotus flowers at their feet, and they can go wherever they want.

Answer: Wherever we think now, that place will immediately appear, isn't that right? Our thinking is similar to the Bodhisattva's way of walking. Wherever we think, our brain immediately appears. This place is not much different from the Western World of Pure Land. There are mandala flowers falling, there are chanting sutras,... Later, when a person reaches heaven, there are no more afflictions. Every day he cultivates his mind and nurtures his nature, recites sutras, worships Buddha, walks everywhere on lotus flowers. Just like in a dream, wherever you want to go, you can go there.

II, THE Sacred Realm of the Spiritual Pure Land (2)
二、 心灵净土圣境（二）

Question: For many consecutive days, the disciple received the holy visions of the Pure Land from Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. Because the disciple's writing is still limited, it is not possible to describe meticulously and completely the Pure Land holy scene. Please forgive Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

October 23, 2018 – Spiritual Pure World :

Translucent clouds float between the mountains, in the air there are golden phoenixes flying with long tails, glowing and sparkling, extremely beautiful. There was a Bodhisattva who flew to the sky above the mountain range where there was a pavilion. In the pavilion, there are Great Bodhisattvas preaching Dharma to the Lesser Bodhisattvas. The pavilion's golden roof glows brightly, the railings are made from white jade, the floor is also made from white jade, sparkling brightly, free of dust. Stepping out into the hallway of the pavilion, there is an incomparably clear lake. The bottom of the lake is strewn with sparkling golden sand. In the lake, which was originally empty, there was suddenly a school of brightly colored carp. The carp's body glowed and sparkled. It swam around a few times, then gradually sank into the sand, then turned into golden sand.

On the white jade stone table, a Great Bodhisattva gently waved his hand and immediately manifested the astrological worlds in the universe, explaining to other Bodhisattvas who came to listen to the Dharma. There was a Bodhisattva who flew up, then flew to the mountain range where the ashram was extremely large. The sign in front of the ashram gate wrote the three words "Avalokiteśvara Village", in the middle worshiped a huge holy statue of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva from the Eastern Dai Dai. Little Bodhisattva knelt down to worship. The holy statue of Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) sparkled and appeared before the little Bodhisattva's eyes. Outside the ashram, there are Bodhisattvas chanting sutras, either sitting or standing, and others are walking around the Buddha chanting. Bodhisattvas in the pure land world can gather together to recite sutras and study the Dharma, or they can also stay alone in the pure land to practice meditation.

This is the Spiritual Pure Land, the residence of disciples after successful cultivation. Bodhisattva said that he hopes that all Buddhists can single-mindedly believe in the Buddha's thoughts. When they die, they will be reborn in the Spiritual Pure Land. There will still be many wonderful scenes that will be told to our disciples later.

October 24, 2018 – Spiritual Pure World :

In the pure land world surrounded by mountains, surrounded by drifting white clouds, inside the mountains sparkling streams of golden light suddenly appear, within those hidden streams of golden light is a cascading palace. The Pure Land world is a palace everywhere. In the middle of the palace there are several very large lakes, with lotus flowers blooming in the lakes. Along both sides of the lake are a series of corridors. Any monk who has just been reborn in the Pure Land will step into the fountain, the clean water immediately emits waves of golden light to cover this saint. After the golden light dissipates, lotus flowers will appear from the bottom of the lake, and the monk will sit on that lotus flower.

Inside the pavilion, the Bodhisattvas gather together, the food and drinks are pure, the fruit will appear before the eyes according to the Bodhisattva's thoughts, the Bodhisattvas use their thoughts to eat food, the taste is excellent. Bodhisattvas in the Pure Land will not think about salty food. All are pure thoughts and pure words. People who eat salty food while reciting Buddha's name will not be able to be reborn in the Pure Land world. Here, it's not like the human world needs smoke and fire to cook, so whatever you think about, you'll have it. All Bodhisattva Bodhisattva Bodhisattvas in the human world will be a direct path to the Spiritual Pure Land World. Bodhisattva Bodhisattva Bodhisattvas will manifest in the Pure Land World

October 25, 2018 – Spiritual Pure World :

In the early morning, the pure land world has no distinction between day and night. Day and night in the pure land are as bright as day. When the day has passed, a new day's bell will ring in the pure land. Bodhisattvas who have entered very deep concentration will not even hear the bell ringing, only focused on their mind, Bodhisattvas in the pure land are not tired, day or night are studying, listening to the Dharma, chanting. business. The lifespan of the Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas in the Pure Land is immeasurable, a number that can never be measured in the human world.

There is a place where there is a stone pillar railing carved from white jade, a sparkling golden dragon wraps around the stone pillar, a pupil approaches the golden dragon, the golden dragon wraps around the  stone pillar and immediately flies out, the pupil sits on the dragon's body and flies towards the distant mountain peak. The top of that mountain is the Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara Village. The pupil and the golden dragon stopped at a pavilion to rest. The dragon's body wrapped around the stone pillar at that pavilion. A number of pupils and dragons listened together to listen to the Great Bodhisattva expound the scriptures while stopping in the pavilion.

Not far away there is a rockery, the water flows from above and then splits into two water lines that slope down to flow into the lake, the water flows sometimes fast and sometimes slow. At the bottom of the lake are large schools of carp, sparkling with light, sometimes hidden and sometimes visible, a moment later the golden light gradually dissipates, then sinks into the golden sand at the bottom of the lake. The Pure Land World is all transformed from ideas, the rockery, the golden carp are all illusory and transformed according to the Bodhisattva idea.

In the lake there is a lotus-shaped fountain, the water in the fountain is clear, sometimes it turns into golden light, sometimes it turns into 7 magical colors, sometimes it sprays straight, sometimes it rotates, sometimes it stands still, extremely magical. On the grass, there is a peacock with its tail spread wide, golden light sparkling around the peacock's body, chanting scriptures, scriptures circulating in the pure land. The rare birds and animals in the Pure Land are not real entities, nor did they come from beings in evil destiniess.

Mandala flowers gently fall in the Pure Land World, some are pink, some are white, under the big tree, the Bodhisattva enters meditation to study, following the Dharma sounds circulating in the air to enhance his mind.

October 26, 2018 – Spiritual Pure World :

Confucius, golden dragons, and phoenixes in the Pure Land World are extremely happy, constantly speaking everywhere in the pure land. There are Buddhas, saints, and venerable beings from the Western Pure Land, inviting Buddhas and Bodhisattvas to go to a certain pure land to listen to the Dharma. The Buddhas and Bodhisattvas in the pure land stopped chanting, and those who had entered concentration came out of concentration. Bodhisattvas with enough magical powers took turns flying on lotus flowers, gathered in the air of a vast square in the Pure Land and then entered meditation, a rain of flowers slowly fell, and the scent spread. The saints in the pure land world respectfully welcome the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas who come from the Western World of Ultimate Bliss to the Spiritual Pure Land. The Buddhas and Bodhisattvas radiate brilliant light and Dharma sounds are transmitted. The Pure Land world is filled with Dharma happiness everywhere.

October 27, 2018 – Spiritual Pure World :

In the distance, a golden light appeared to shine at the entrance gate of the Pure Land World, the Pure Land World welcomed a lay Bodhisattva who had just been reborn to the Spiritual Pure Land. Protected by Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, escort the Bodhisattva who has just been reborn to this pure land to the lake of merit to wash.

The Eight Merits Pond is extremely large, the water in the pond emits a sparkling golden light, the lay Bodhisattva stands on the pond with both feet, the water flows up from under his feet and begins to surround this Bodhisattva's entire body, washing away all the impurities in the world, his spiritual body restores its luminous nature. When he was born, this lay person lived a vegetarian life, recited Buddha's name and practiced pure practice, maintained good intentions, worked hard to make merit, firmly held the idea of being reborn in the Buddha Land, and at the time of his life, Buddhas and Bodhisattvas came to protect him. In one thought, he was immediately reborn in the Buddha Land.

After washing, the Bodhisattva Bodhisattva immediately appeared gentle, with no wrinkles on his face, clean and smooth. In a few pavilion, the Elder Bodhisattvas used their hands to gently point at the white jade stone table, and the table surface immediately appeared to show the shape of the dharma realm of sentient beings in Sa Ba Kingdom. Bodhisattvas of lower status are listening to the wonderful sounds of the Dharma, seeing sentient beings in the evil and deluded world, constantly sighing, their hearts filled with compassion.

The Buddhas and Bodhisattvas in the Pure Land all have pure thoughts, there are no evil thoughts or evil words in their minds, each thought is extremely pure. People who want to be reborn in this Buddha Land must practice pure magical speech and a pure land without evil appearances

Answer: The Spiritual Pure Land World is the same as the Western Pure Land World, just in two different locations. Just like today there are many very clean and beautiful cities, each clean and beautiful city is similar. Where do pure lands like the above get their evil appearance? As for the current human world, I don't know how many evil forms there are?

Master's dharma body is handling a lawsuit against a disciple who has violated Buddhist precepts. There is a huge screen that appears in the air, showing the disciples the tragic scene in the hell of sexual misconduct.

Scenes in the Hell of sexual misconduct:

In the dark cave, there is a very large lake, as big as about 3-4 football fields combined, the lake is very deep. There are many souls (both men and women) immersed in it, only the head is not submerged, the souls all make extremely sad sounds, heart-breaking screams, I get goosebumps when I hear it, it is not a normal cry that people in the world can imagine, very terrifying, echoing everywhere in the cave.

The screen in the air changed to another scene, a spirit being was sent to the shore of the lake, his face was in pain, his whole body was covered in feces water in the excrement pit, his whole body smelt so bad that he couldn't smell it, he was crying and said: "After I was thrown into the excrement pit by the government officials, my ears, nose, and mouth were immediately flooded with excrement lake, very stinky, so bad that I almost fainted to death. That Dung Pit is similar to the excrement pit in the human world, the entire area is full of feces." inside is all excrement, moreover, the fecal water after contact with the spiritual body is painful to the bone. In the fecal lake water there are insects and small creatures whose names I don't know, biting at us sinners in the excrement pit. The excrement pit is large and deep, there is no shore, even if you can swim to the shore, there is no way to climb up, because the whole body is slimy, smooth, inherently impossible to climb up, you can only suffer forever in the excrement pit

On the transition screen, another scene of hell appeared. There is a very large cave, the space in this hell is red with fire, the air is very hot, underneath there are many iron beds, on each iron bed there are sharp nails, under the iron bed there is a fire, each nail is heated to a bright red. The scene ended, my thoughts also woke up from a coma

II, Avīci Hell (Relentless Hell) (HELL OF blaspheming Buddha)
二、 无间地狱（谤佛地狱）

Question: On August 3, 2018, after worshiping Buddha at Guanyin Hall, the disciple received a revelation about the Hell of Blaspheming the Buddha (Hell of No Interruption). Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva instructed his disciples to bring the ideas they received that day to the Master. After the Master confirms, they can post them on the internet to warn the world to absolutely not slander any Dharma practice, any faith (any religion) and anyone who propagates the Dharma practice.

Those who were sent to hell are extremely miserable, remember carefully, remember carefully! Those who study Buddhism while still alive must not maliciously slander the three jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Sangha) and must not withhold their wealth. Even if they do not practice, they must not arbitrarily and indiscriminately defame people for propagating the Dharma.

The Scene in the Avīci Hell (Relentless Hell) :

The large screen covered the entire front of the Buddha altar at Guanyin Hall, a scene of hell appeared. A few sinners were oppressed by the Dharma Protector and knelt before Dharma Protector Bodhisattva. His face was solemn. In the air, the Quan Am Hall was full of Heavenly Soldiers and Heavenly Generals, everyone extremely majestic. After the underworld official finished sentencing the crime, a black path suddenly appeared on the floor of Guan Am Duong. After that black path opened, mournful screams immediately rang out (it can be said as miserable screams), more terrifying than any sound in horror movies in the human world can describe, extremely scary, I got goosebumps when I heard it.

The sinful spirit was immediately pushed down that black path, falling directly into the Great Hell of Unending Hell. The Dharma Protector told me that in this hell, anyone who slanders the true Dharma or true beliefs (any religion) will be dragged to this hell and severely punished. After the sinful spirit fell into hell, the terrified expression and thoughts of the sinful spirit were transmitted to the screen in Guan Am Hall. All the feelings, including the temperature in hell, the sight of hell, the fear and suffering of the sinner spirit, all felt like I had been in this scene myself. It is a scene that no science and technology in the human world can invent (this is the underworld). A demon that looks different from the other demons in hell appears (different from other hells that I have seen, demons in other hells are like us mortals, some wear ancient uniforms, some wear modern uniforms. Based on the different terrain, the demons governing hell are also different), tall and tall, about as tall as 7 to 8 people combined, some are black, some are Indian, their appearance is very fierce, just looking at it makes me feel very scared. Unlike a human face, the facial expression is a bit similar to a cow's, but the body is human

Previously, I shared that all four directions in the Unbroken Hell are molten lava, extremely high temperatures. The ghost grabbed that sinful spirit, then looked up into the sky in hell and asked a few questions. In the air, there was a voice echoing in the air saying what crime this sinful spirit had committed and how many years it must be punished (this sinful spirit must suffer 10,000 years in hell, I don't know how the time in hell is calculated, 10,000 years is equivalent to how many years in the human world. I asked Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, but Bodhisattva only shed tears and said nothing). The devil of hell used his hand to hit the lava (the devil's strength was extremely strong). Red molten lava flowed out. The devil used a very large weapon to hold the lava, his other hand grabbed the sinner's mouth, let the sinner struggle, it was useless (because the devil's strength was very great), poured spoonfuls of lava into the sinner's mouth.

The sinful spirit immediately let out a heart-wrenching scream (It's truly too scary, the sinful spirit's punishment in other hells is not as painful), the sinful spirit's thoughts passed to the screen: "It hurts so much, Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara, ever since the lava entered my mouth, the pain of life is worse than death. The lava is like fire burning all my internal organs, the outer layer of skin immediately turns black, the whole body smokes, the eyes and ears immediately bleed, the pain It's so simple! Every moment is as long as 10,000 years. I don't want to stay in this hell for another second. I shouldn't have slandered the Bodhisattva and the Dharma Protector of the Spiritual Dharma, creating great evil karma. I shouldn't have said that the Spiritual Dharma is demonic, demonic, and superstitious."

Every sinner in this hell is black, I can't recognize their face. As long as the lava on his body turns off, the devil will continue to pour lava into his mouth. Every second in this hell is being punished, until the end of the punishment period.

The screen turns off, This is the idea that I receive in my most alert state.

Answer: Those who slander Buddha Dharma, one by one, will be punished. It will happen sooner or later. It's not that there's no warning, it's that the time hasn't come yet. Has the Master who has been propagating the Dharma from the past until now ever said anything bad about other Dharma methods? This hell of slandering the Buddha is the result of speaking nonsense. When you have a nightmare, do you feel scared? Defame it until later when you suffer. When evil comes to retribution, even Bodhisattvas cannot save them. Tall ghosts in hell with buffalo heads and horse faces specialize in serving punishments in the underworld.

– Master Lu Lu opened the discussion to answer questions (247). August 16, 2018

Question: On the morning of August 17, 2018, I received the thoughts of Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) and Dharma Protector Bodhisattva.  Because people in the present world have heavy habits, do not understand the cause and effect of Buddha Dharma, there are more and more people who create karma, and there are more and more people who slander, so I constantly send scenes from hell to you, so that I can tell the disciples and Buddhist friends who practice the Spiritual Dharma: "You must definitely believe in your Master, do not look at articles that slander the Buddha, between disciples must unite and love each other to propagate the Spiritual Dharma of Avalokiteśvara Bo. Slap, don't let untrue gossip shake your mind of Buddha's teachings. During the end of the Dharma, people indulge in too much entertainment, disciples must strive to practice and listen to many recordings of teachings. Your Master's , especially can help you become enlightened and destroy many evil obstacles. Your Master has worked too hard, all disciples, please listen to me Linh, regardless of whether you are a Buddha friend or a disciple, Bodhisattvas all consider you to be disciples of the Buddha."

After the disciple worshiped Buddha and went home to rest for a while, he immediately felt his body lighten up, his soul was lifted up by the Dharma Protector, and a moment later he reached the underworld.

The devil ordered the gate of hell to open the door to let me in. I went to a quite high open space, below was a very large flat area, the atmosphere was gloomy, there were many evil spirits (both men and women), some people had faces as if they were floating dreamily, some people looked very miserable. In the air of this hell, there are many types of instruments. If you look closely, you can see that the instruments are all kinds of books, tablets, phones, computers (some are new computers, there are also old ones from around 1998), and televisions (there are old and new televisions alternating on them). These instruments float above the heads of sinners.

These punishments are to punish the sinful thoughts of sexual misconduct. People on earth think that watching these things is very happy, but do not know that once the seeds of evil karma are planted in the brain, they immediately become the consequences of evil karma, accumulating day after day until the evil results are ripe. When alive, if you do not do good things, you will fall into this place. Only by reciting sutras and worshiping Buddha, sowing many good causes, and making efforts to repent and make amends can the evil consequences ripen.

A middle-aged male criminal, with a laptop hanging above his head, the criminal's face had an infatuated expression. Then, the computer opened, and inside immediately emitted electric rays that shot directly into the sinner's eyes. The screaming sinner was electrocuted all over his body, unable to move. The electric light continued to fire for a long time, about 7 or 8 minutes passed, the electric light disappeared, the consciousness of the sinful spirit fainted, his whole body was smoking and lying on the ground, the computer flew away. "It's a sin born of the mind. When you're alive, whatever tools you use to commit sexual misconduct (computers, laptops, or books for sexual misconduct), after death, your consciousness will recreate these tools to punish you. These sins are all caused by watching dirty things, books, and depraved movies day after day. It's just that while you're alive, your body doesn't create too many evil karmas of sexual misconduct, so you fall into this hell." Having finished speaking, Ho Phap took me to the elevator entrance to the earthly world. I stepped in and the door closed. When the door opened, I woke up and returned to the living world.

In the air above the Buddha altar, a very large screen flew down, covering the entire Buddha Hall. In the air, the Bodhisattva's thoughts came: "Disciple, listen to the command, tell all the scenes you witness in hell to the people of the world. Now I will take you to see the karma of hell." Scenes in Hell of Verbal Karma: Punishing those who speak evilly, speak double words, slander good knowledge, and instigate separatism

After that, the ghost stretched out the tip of the sinner's tongue and used a nail to nail the tongue to the ground. The sinner half knelt and half crawled to be punished, his hands could not move, his mouth could not speak. Many sinners are fixed on the ground to be punished like that.

A sinful spirit is being tied up, crying miserably, frightened, tied tightly to the table. The ghost took the tools, these tools were heated through a large fire, pulled out the tongue, then used the tool to cut off the tongue, the sinner cried out in pain. The ghost said: "When this person was alive, he liked to chat and gossip, but he made up lies to create verbal karma with people who studied Buddhism, committing great evil verbal karma, causing him to fall into hell after death, not even having a tongue. Let's see if he can still commit verbal karma." On the second day, the tongue of the guilty soul will grow back on its own, and the devil will continue to cut it off until he is released from hell. Not long after that, I woke up.

Answer: This person is really awesome, what she said is completely true, it's really scary. That is why Venerable Monks will not speak casually. I saw the Great Dharma Master in the temple, I talked a lot to him, but he only replied to me with one sentence, "Amitābha Buddha", he will not tell me much about worldly things. Opening your mouth is karma. It's extremely painful, don't wait until then to be afraid, quickly become enlightened, there's nothing worth mentioning.

You too, absolutely must not watch depraved things. We are humans, we cannot look at things like animals, it's really not good at all, it's disgusting. If we take humans down a level, for example, say our entire being becomes a sheep, then only sheep and sheep will look at each other? You are human, would you go look at sheep? Therefore, everyone must understand this principle and absolutely not take it lightly.

— Chief Lu Dai answered the question letter (No. 259). September 29, 2018

八、 大油锅地狱

Question: On October 7, 2018, as usual after worshiping Buddha, at the Guanyin Hall reciting Sutras, only clouds were seen surrounding the Guanyin Hall. A moment later, the disciple's consciousness fell into a deep sleep, vaguely reaching the top of a hell.

The Great Oil Pan Hell: Sins that were buried in their consciences while alive, countless evil deeds, heinous crimes, after being punished in other hells, will continue to fall into this hell, thrown into the oil pan and their souls will fly away

In this hell, there are about 7 or 8 rows of large oil pans, each row has about a dozen boiling oil pans neatly distributed in this hell. An oil pan can contain many sins. In front of the oil pan, there is a sign hanging to distinguish names from different countries. It turns out that sinners from different countries who commit crimes that destroy their conscience and are cruel to heaven and earth that cannot be forgiven, after being punished in other great hells, will be brought to this hell, dipped in a pan of oil, and fried until their souls fly away. The oil pan in this hell is extremely large, the ghosts in charge of execution here are taller than the ghosts in Vo Cock hell, and their strength is extremely strong and incomparable. A ghost there told me: "I am a ghost who enforces the law in this hell. In the past, there were not so many oil pans in this hell, and the oil pans were very small. Nowadays, the age is increasingly developing, the speed at which people create karma is also extremely fast. People in the past did not dare to do bad things, but today's people, for money, for fame, for profit, dare to save everything, dare to steal, dare to rob, there is no bad thing that they do not dare to do, so new oil pans are constantly increasing. We just need to receive a warning after declaring all the sins that this sinful spirit has created, the spirit body will immediately be thrown into the oil pan, fried until the soul flies away, and this world will no longer have this spirit body. Nowadays, many people in the human world look bright, rich and have status, but in the dark, many of them have practiced evil things in their previous lives, and have come down to the human world. Currently, the underworld is listing those who are still alive in this world. Just waiting for the blessings and virtues to run out, the ghosts will immediately order them to arrest them, drag them to the palace of the King Yama to be judged, and after falling into the great hells to be punished, they will continue to be transferred here to be thrown into the oil pan. If they have a good reputation and power in the human world, what if they can't take it with them, they only have their karma with them, what a pity, pitiful!"

The ghost escorted a male criminal, holding a piece of paper and declared: "Criminal X, from country Y, is a leader-level figure, embezzled against the law, hired people to kill people related to his political interests, harmed righteous people, committed countless crimes of sexual misconduct, and even took advantage of his power to threaten and rape women. Although no one knows in this world, heaven and earth do not forgive, and after death, he is sentenced to hell. Otherwise, it will continue to be thrown into the oil pan.” Having finished speaking, one hand grabbed this sinful spirit and threw it into the oil pan. The sinful spirit sank to the bottom of the pan, the sound of the soul frying "sizzling, sizzle, sizzle" was heard. In an instant, the bones were fried until they evaporated, leaving only debris floating in the oil pan. Black smoke rose from the bottom of the pan and clung to the black residue. The devil ordered a filter racket to scoop out the black residue and pour it into the drain in front of the oil pan.

Another criminal was the same, holding a piece of paper and declaring: "Criminal X, from country Y, has great influence in the country, has a noble social status, but colludes with unscrupulous businessmen, oppresses people, embezzles a large amount of money from the country, and is related to countless human lives. Although no one in the human world knows the crime he has committed, after death he will go to hell to suffer first, and after being punished, he will be thrown away. into the oil pan.”

Another sin: "Criminal X, an emperor from country Y, covered up shady money-laundering organizations, colluded with the nation's weapons smuggling merchants, helped the nobles indulge in sex and make huge profits from it, committing sexual misconduct. After death, he will also be thrown into the great hell to suffer first, and after being punished, he will be thrown into the oil pan."

Criminal Linh After death, he will be thrown into the great hell to suffer, and after being punished, he will be thrown into an oil pan."

After watching, the disciple's consciousness regained consciousness and returned to the earthly world

IX, THE FIRE HELL (IMMORTAL HELL)
九、 火热地狱（敛财地狱）

On the morning of August 28, 2018, while in a daze, I vaguely heard a voice saying: "I am Living Buddha Ji Gong, receiving the instructions of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva to take you on a trip to the underworld, don't be afraid."

In my dream, I followed Te Cong Bodhisattva to a place in hell, a very large city gate appeared before my eyes, there were 2 huge ghosts (as tall as the city gate) holding old weapons to stop us, asking: "Who are you, this is an important place in hell, do not trespass"

The Bodhisattva Ji Cong emitted a golden light and told the ghosts: "I am the Bodhisattva Ji Gong. I received the instructions of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva to take the disciples of the Spiritual Dharma to travel to this hell. Return to the earthly world to tell the world the retribution of using the name of the Spiritual Dharma to conserve money and think about the Little House."

Having finished speaking, the ghost opened the big gate for me to enter. I followed Te Cong Bodhisattva and moved to a small passage. The environment in the underworld is very similar to the earthly world, only the environment in the underworld is like our night, without seeing light. Bodhisattva Te Cong Bodhisattva's body emitted golden light. I followed the Bodhisattva to a very high place, then stopped moving forward. Te Cong Bodhisattva pointed to a modern architectural building in the distance, a building about 30 or 40 floors high. Not far away, there is still construction going on. There are ghosts building new floors. That's because recently the underworld has been built for those who are currently using the name of the Spiritual Dharma to save their money and recite the Careless Little House. They will later be condemned to this hell.

I took a look, this place is not the same as the hells I have seen before (previously I was taken to see Vo Gian hell, Ta Dam hell, Blasphemy Khau Nghiep hell. After returning to earth, I felt unwell for many hours), but here I don't feel scared at all, why is this an important place in hell? I also don't see any criminals being punished in this area.

Te Cong Bodhisattva immediately smiled, gently shook the fan, the golden light emitted from the fan turned into a large screen appearing in front of him. “Let me show you the evil spirits currently living in those buildings.” Each small space appeared, holding many sinful souls. When I saw this, my face immediately changed in horror. I asked the Bodhisattva: "Why are there so many magicians?" Most of those people are magicians, there are also a small number of normal people like us.

Ji Cong Bodhisattva replied: "Reciting the Little House casually, deceiving the gods and demons of heaven and earth. The Little House is passed down from heaven and earth, is the great vow power of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, and is a Buddhist dharma object. People in the world think that it is just a small yellow page of paper and do not recite it properly (there are some shamans and people in the world today who, by reciting a few changes, end up entire pages of scriptures), and even borrow Buddhist dharma objects to save money (Pendants). Bodhisattva, Little House (XFZ), protection card, Bodhisattva statue of Spiritual Dharma, buying and selling Buddha beads online), this is their hell retribution.

A moment later, a sound came from the air: "It's time, light the fire!", I don't know where the fire came from, and in an instant surrounded the entire building. I saw the sinners being imprisoned in small rooms, the sound of fear rang out, these sinners were burned alive inside until they died, it was truly both pitiful and terrifying. I couldn't bear to look anymore, so I told the Bodhisattva: "I don't want to see anymore." Te Cong Bodhisattva immediately took back his fan, from afar came the screams of sinful souls, I cried like rain. Here, every hour, fires will be set on fire for these sinful souls. Depending on the amount of karma they have created in the human world, the detention time will be different, some people will be detained for 1 year, others will be detained for 20, 30 years, every day they will have to endure the suffering of burning fire until they are released from hell.

Bodhisattva saw that I was sad and immediately told the ghost to take me out. I followed the ghost and sent him to the elevator (this is the elevator that connects to the human world, currently in the underworld it is all about modernized architecture). I pressed button number 1, the elevator went up, the door opened, I woke up immediately.

Disciple, August 28, 2018

Question: On October 22, 2018, after paying homage to Buddha at Guanyin Hall, while I sat down to recite sutras, after a while my mind fell into a deep sleep, and my soul was lifted up by Ji Cong Hoat Phat and took me to a place in hell.

Hell of Fire and Heat: Specialized in Punishing and Treating Disorders Little House (XFZ) Recitation, Borrowing the Name of the Spiritual Dharma of Recollecting Wealth

The Little House (XFZ) is a gift from heaven and earth, the great vow of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, and a Buddhist dharma object. People in the world think that it is just a small yellow page, without reciting it properly (there are some shamans and people in the world today who, depending on their thoughts, immediately end the entire page of scripture), and even borrow Buddhist dharma objects to conceal their wealth (Bodhisattva pendants, Small Houses, protective cards, Bodhisattva statues of Spiritual Dharma, buying and selling Buddha beads online), this is their retribution in hell.

Go to a very high place, under the ground are all modern architecture, some buildings are still under construction, some ghosts are building new floors, that is because recently the underworld has been built for those who are currently using the name of Spiritual Dharma to save their money, recite the Careless Little House, and will later be doomed to live in this hell.

I took a look, this place is not like the hells I have seen before (previously I was taken to see the Vo Cock hell, the Ta Dam hell, the Blasphemy Khao Nghiep hell, the scenes were all very scary), but here I don't feel scared at all.

I walked closer to a building that had been completed, inside the building was pitch black, inside there were rows of single prisons holding dozens of criminals, outside the prison there were no doors, only iron bars built around them. I went into a room there, saw a body burned black, I could barely recognize the face of the sinner lying groaning on the ground. Every hour on the wire, a fire will be set to burn these guilty souls. Depending on the level of karma they created while on earth, the detention time will vary, some people will be imprisoned for 1 year, others will be imprisoned for 20, 30 years. Every day he has to endure the agony of the burning fire, so when he finishes his sentence, he will be released from hell.

The spirit body transmitted the thought: "I was run over by a car and died. When I was alive, I crazy created verbal karma about Spiritual Dharma, saying a lot of bad words. In fact, I don't have a deep understanding of Buddha Dharma. I don't understand that Spiritual Dharma is all passed down by Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. When I was alive, I created too many evil consequences and did not understand the Buddhist precepts. Please develop a heart of compassion and mercy on me. I pray to Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and Dharma Protector Bodhisattva. Slap. Please bring these words of mine after my death back to the living world, so that my punishment can be reduced, and I can soon escape from hell and avoid being sent to the animal world."

At this time, a spirit's thoughts came from another cell: "IX is a shaman from country Y. I have not yet practiced. I did not know that this is a Buddhist dharma passed down from heaven. After death, I will fall into hell. Because when I was alive, I recited sutras to make merit, so the time I was detained was quite short, and I could still be reincarnated into a family with Buddha's fate. But every day, I had to endure the agony of the burning fire. I really couldn't stand it. I was in detention every day." repent, you are a disciple of the Spiritual Dharma, please pray on my behalf, I know how to repent, please Buddha and Bodhisattva have mercy on me."

When I saw this, I cried speechlessly. After clasping my hands and saying goodbye to the spirit, I found the elevator to return to earth

Answer:I tell you to absolutely not create verbal karma, those who create verbal karma will definitely fall down. Many people in the past were careless in chanting Little House. There were magicians who had just recited the once and finished the entire page, waiting until they died to know. Hell is truly miserable. As humans, don't lose sight of your future. Every move you make in the present will affect the future. For example, many people smoke today, but do they know that they will develop lung cancer in the future? Many people never stop drinking alcohol when they are young. How do you know if you will develop liver cancer later? That is the morality. If you scold others, you never know that one day you will be scolded back. Everyone has to be really careful and not do that. Spiritual Dharma today is getting better and better, more and more people practice it, just think about it and you will understand.

– The head of the radio station opened up to answer questions (264) November 10, 2018

一、游地府，听阎王讲阴律与善恶因果

Question :October 24, 2018, nearly causing frequent trips to hell, today the officials in the underworld invited me to meet a high-ranking official of the Underworld - King Yama. In my dream, I also came across a modern architectural building. When I went inside, I saw the King Yama sitting in front of the palace. I was extremely surprised, because it was all modern equipment, just like our offices today.

King Yama has a calm face, looking very majestic, I put my hands together to worship the King Yama.

The King Yama said: "I am responsible for managing the life and death of country There is a Dharma Protector Bodhisattva of that dharma to guide him back to heaven or the pure land of Buddha.

While alive, if you are neither good nor evil, and do not want to be reincarnated into the human world, you will reside in the underworld. In the underworld, there are also houses and scenery just like in the human world, only the living space is different. The terrain in the underworld is complex, beyond human understanding. I give you a communication phone, you take it back and give it to Dharma Protector Bodhisattva. Later, when you travel to hell, notify the underworld, I will arrange someone to pick you up

There are Dharmas that have been passed down in the human world for many ages, such as Dharma X. The Spiritual Dharma of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva is considered a fairly new Buddhist method here. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva in this heaven and earth is not known to anyone. The Underworld also knows this Bodhisattva (Because the country where the disciple lives has many religious dharmas, the underworld official in front of him looks a bit like an Arab). In fact, no matter what method you follow, each religion will be based on the principle of cause and effect between heaven and earth, that is, good will be rewarded with good, evil will be rewarded with evil. Doing good with your heart is the true dharma, the principle of each religion.

Our laws here are based on the law of cause and effect to punish. You worldly people are stupid, do not understand cause and effect, nor do you understand the law of sound, you must know that if you create verbal karma about the Spiritual Dharma, I will record it in the book. If it is a small amount of speech, it will be considered a small evil deed, but if it is a great evil deed, I will record it as a great evil deed. The retribution is yours to bear. After death, don't ask me for forgiveness. I will only judge based on the retribution. The underworld governs the results, not the people. If you have merit while you are still in this world, I will use that merit to deduct it, and then based on the causes and conditions that you have created to deal with it. No matter what method it is, there is a way to make merit of that method, and there will also be different Dharma Protectors to manage it. If we say that the book of life and death will be managed by my underworld, then it is better to say that it will be written by you yourself who create evil and create good.

You people of the world are very stupid, it's better not to talk about things you don't know. You've only practiced for a few years and you think you understand everything. Do you know everything when heaven and earth are vast? Do you understand all the many dharmas? There are also people who practice religion but commit sexual misconduct and lies. Are they still people who practice religion? The practitioners we talk about here include those who practice all methods in the world, of course including Spiritual Methods.

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva is truly compassionate. He always begs the heavens not to pass down orders to punish you sentient beings, saying that you are ignorant and pitiful. He always asks the Dharma Protectors in heaven and earth to have mercy on those who create karma for you. Can't good and evil be distinguished in the mind? Good and evil results are all created by oneself, it is due to one's own ignorance, not understanding cause and effect and creating karma. Do you still have the face to blame heaven and earth? Bodhisattva is compassionate to you, but does not tolerate you creating bad karma.

Your Master understands heaven and earth and is strict with your disciples because he knows about the consequences, the consequences must be borne personally, do you understand? (This underworld official uses Arabic to communicate with me, but in my mind, I understand everything the King Yama is saying. I use Chinese to communicate with the underworld official, and he also understands what I mean).

The secretaries here are very busy, all day long recording the good and evil of you people in this world, you even dare to talk back and forth between sects, below I see it's all verbal karma, you guys are so stupid! ”

Speaking of this, I curiously asked: "If a foreigner dies in my country, how will the underworld handle it?". The King Yama rolled his eyes and looked at his son: "It's okay to tell you. If they die in our country, the soul will be brought down here by the demons patrolling the earthly world (the demons here wear police uniforms), then we'll find out where their nationality is. The underworld has a connecting path and will arrange to bring them back to their home country to manage. If a foreigner resides here and creates karma in our country, I will write an official document based on how much karma there is, and then escorted to the underworld in their country. There are great hells that will receive punishment for sinners from many different countries. The underworld of all countries has direct access to the hells. If we decide to send them here, we will consider our country's citizens under our control.

Okay, you go back, try to practice, your Dharma Protector Bodhisattvas are all very great, always silently protecting you, don't do bad things. Go back and thank Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva for always being compassionate and saving you sentient beings, without you even knowing it. Don't talk nonsense, where has your conscience gone?"

A moment later, my consciousness regained consciousness.

Answer :There are too many things revealed in the underworld for you to see, so you must not do anything wrong. Studying Buddhism is not something that can be taken lightly. Haven't many people left at a very young age? On the surface, it seems like they have cancer or other evil diseases, but in reality it is due to their karma. Many people in the past talked too much, had sharp tongues, and mocking others also created bad karma. If you're not careful, you can create verbal karma right away. When karma comes, even if you're young, you'll be dragged away.

– Head of the station Lu opened the door to answer questions (265) November 17, 2018

The King Yama invited his son to sit down and said: "Today the underworld is extremely busy. For some reasons, I was transferred here from another palace. In the future, I will be specifically in charge of all spiritual Dharma duties here (country Y). Today I have a few words of hope that you will return to convey to the people in the earthly world that from time immemorial, good will be rewarded with good, evil will be rewarded with evil, everything is self-created cause and effect, no matter what dharma or religion. are the same, all living beings are equal before cause and effect. After death, many people are escorted to the underworld to judge because when they were alive, they did not study Buddhism, did not have religious beliefs, did not understand cause and effect, and even used human thinking to make excuses with us underworld officials.

“Little girl, you have the predestined relationship to travel to this underworld, I only hope that you can convey this message to those who study the Spiritual Dharma: Just make an effort to practice, follow your Master's words, do not do evil deeds, practice well, then after death there will be a Dharma Protector Bodhisattva of the sect (Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva) to take you back to the Pure Land of Buddha. If you do not practice diligently, just don't do bad things, there will still be an afterlife. can be reincarnated into a good family. If you don't practice well and still do bad things, little girl, I tell you, I don't care what dharma or ashram, after death, you will be punished according to all the evil karma you have created."

At this time, there was a ghost (wearing a police uniform) escorting a spirit body down. The King Yama told the ghost to bring a machine (like a weight weighing machine), told the spirit to step up, the needle on the screen displayed a number, the King Yama glanced and said: "Reincarnated into the human world", the spirit will be taken to another place.

The King Yama told his son: "This machine is used to measure how much a person's spiritual body weighs. Whoever creates bad karma will automatically be enveloped by black gas. If he is alive and does small good deeds or small evil deeds, after death, his soul body will be gray-white in color. If the weight is extremely heavy, he will fall into hell. If this scale is broken, exceeding 100%, then this soul body will fall to the great hells to receive retribution, and continue after the punishment is over. thrown into a pan of oil, causing the soul to fry until its soul flies away.

Sometimes, many spiritual beings who have just passed away, if they know that they will be sent to hell or to the animal world, will not accept it, and will still stand in front of the Palace of King Yama demanding a dispute. My underworld has a camera, I just need to tell them to stand in front of the camera, shine it straight into their consciousness (a - lai - da - consciousness), all the good and evil they have created automatically appear in front of the camera, making them unable to justify.

There are evil spirits who dare to dare to shout loudly in front of my Palace of King Yama, thinking that they are still in the human world and can act strangely. I will order the law enforcement ghosts nearby to use sticks to beat them (law enforcement ghosts are different from normal law enforcement ghosts, law enforcement ghosts are taller than ordinary sinners, very ferocious), they will often be beaten to death and resurrected, extremely tragic, and then escorted to hell.

Your Master often says that he sees black and white energy when looking at totems, but he is just seeing the true form of spiritual entities in the world. Where is the reason to call it nonsense? Hell is always fair, do you mortals know how vast this land is, the complex terrain is beyond the measurements you know in this world. Even if you are still living in the world (this only includes those who practice all dharmas, monastics or lay people), if you have not practiced, then you will not fully understand a part of the world. Only those who in this world have great supernatural powers and Buddhahood can clearly understand the affairs of heaven and earth. Do you think that all people who practice Buddhism are people with Buddhahood? just receiving the grace of Buddha and Bodhisattva to practice in Buddha's place. Being arrogant and high in merit, in human language, is called ruining one's future, making one's practice wasteful.

The person who slanders the Buddha Dharma, our underworld is hunting for it, receives Buddha's favor and says bad things about the Buddha. If while alive, he does not make an effort to repent to the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas and the Great Dharma Protectors, Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) of the Spiritual Dharma, and sincerely make changes, then the evil consequences that come will have to be borne personally."

Answer:If you don't listen to the Master's words, you won't know until you die. It'll be too late to cry. Absolutely do not do evil things, listen to the Master, do not speak nonsense, Master has never allowed you to talk about other methods, talking about Dharma is something that creates karma, just keep yourself well.

– Head of the station Lu opened and answered questions (265) November 17, 2028

noi_dung:
III, THE HOLY SCRIPT INSTRUCTIONS FOR TRAVELING TO THE UNDERLAND, REALIZING THE SUPERIOR SMALL HOUSE AND PURIFYING THE EVIL KARMA OF SPIRITS
三、领卷轴游地府，实见小房子超度净化灵体恶业

On October 29, 2018, in a dream, the disciple fell into a deep sleep. Quan Binh Bodhisattva instructed the disciple to hold the communicator firmly, today there is an official dispatch that needs to be given to a high-ranking official of Dia Phu - King Yama. The disciple received the dispatch, and his soul was taken by a stream of golden light to the underworld's workplace.

King Yama sat on the street. The disciple told King Yama to explain the reason for coming here, then handed the scroll to King Yama. After King Yama opened it and read it, he signaled for his son to stand aside. After a while, the King Yama read all the dispatches and told his son that the decree had been issued in heaven and that he needed to bring some matters back to the earthly world.

"Because the dharmas in heaven and earth are not the same, between heaven and earth there will be corresponding ashrams manifested in the human world to save sentient beings. The teachings and means of practice of each dharma, if one does not have profound morality, it is impossible to understand. Regarding those who practice the path of the Spiritual Dharma, this official can tell you, all they have to do is break the precepts or break their vows, deceive Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, not respect their teachers, and violate their verbal karma, all There will be a Great Dharma Protector of the Dharma - Guan Di Bodhisattva who will order the Dharma Protectors under him to punish (especially the disciples). Those who, while alive, know how to practice great repentance with Buddha and Bodhisattva, will consider the severity of the matter and deal with it. If that person's evil consequences pile up, a dispatch will be written from heaven and delivered to the underworld, the underworld will be in charge of enforcing the law.

Your Dharma Protector wants to prevent Buddhists from committing countless crimes because they do not understand the retribution of hell, so they have repeatedly sent your soul to the underworld to visit and tell people on earth.

Next, I will tell you how the Little House (XFZ) (Energy Sutra) in the underworld can transcend and purify the negative karma of spiritual beings. The Little House is made up of the combined energy of four types of Buddhist scriptures. People on earth today, because they have committed countless negative karmas, have formed black energy clinging to their spiritual entities (this is the black energy and karma that Master talks about every time he looks at totems). Based on all the negative karma created, spiritual entities will be roughly classified into: white gray, dark gray and dark black. The spiritual body of a person's dark black color has extremely heavy negative karma, most of them will fall into hell (last time I traveled to the underworld, the King Yama explained to me about the weight of the spiritual body).”

At this time, the King Yama showed me a screen: A spiritual being received a Little House that a living relative chanted for. The Little House was blessed by the Bodhisattva, glowing brightly. The spiritual body was originally gray in color. The energy of the four types of scriptures in the Little House turned into golden light and penetrated into the spiritual body, the black energy on the spiritual body became lighter. "This spirit body did not commit too many bad karma when it was alive, so the number of energy panels needed by the scriptures is not too much. There are spirits who did not do good deeds when they were alive, and after death they will fall into the realm of hungry ghosts. At this time, if their living relatives learn the Spiritual Dharma of reciting the Little House to transcend, they will take the Little House and exchange it for money from the underworld, helping to make life in the underworld better. Spirits who do not want to be reincarnated or the opportunity for reincarnation has not yet come will stay in the underworld. The underworld and the scenery in the underworld and the human world are identical, one side is positive, the other side is negative.

"By the way, this King also said about those who are still living cultivating the path, reciting sutras while eating salty food, the energy of the scriptures will be very weak, the golden light formed from the energy of the combination of 4 types of scriptures is very weak. People who eat salty things kill living beings (kill living beings) and recite the scriptures with their mouths, I tell you, there is not even a bit of energy. Those cultivating the path are not at a high level and cannot stop eating salty foods, they have to recite a lot < Rebirth Mantra > In order to overcome animal spirits, unless a person has evil karma, abstains from killing and eats a vegetarian diet, assuming that he has transcended the animal spirits on his body, all the evil karma he has created will turn into black gas that sticks to his soul. He needs to make efforts to practice Buddhism while he is alive (Do a lot of merit) to make up for all the killing karma he has created."
Speaking of this, the King Yama pressed the communicator, I took the communicator, and under the golden light of Bodhisattva Dharma Protector returned to the earthly world.

– The head of the station opened his mouth to answer questions (265) November 17, 2018

noi_dung:
IV, IN King Yama'S PALACE, I MEET THE SINNER REPENTING IN THE CASE OF BROTHERS FIGHTING FOR PROPERTY WHICH KILLED PEOPLE
四、 阎王殿见兄弟争产杀人案罪灵忏悔

Question: On October 30, 2018, today the disciple received the will of Guan Binh Bodhisattva. The King Yama had something he wanted the disciple to go to the underworld to take the sacred scroll of the Spiritual Dharma and hand it over to the underworld to handle. When the disciple closes his eyes and rests at home, the soul is taken by a golden light to the underworld. The King Yama opened the sacred scroll and read it, then used his official seal to stamp the sacred scroll and then handed the sacred scroll back to the disciple and instructed the disciple to bring it back and return it to the guardian of the Spiritual Dharma. Not long after, the King Yama told his disciples: "Today the Underworld has just received a ghost. During his lifetime, he was a relative of a disciple of the Spiritual Dharma. Because there was a relative who practiced the Spiritual Dharma and had done great merit, after his death he was saved by Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara), so that he could meet his disciple to explain the situation in detail and especially share the case of this case to the earthly world, warning those who practice the Spiritual Dharma not to be greedy for fame and fortune. Of the world's glory and wealth, in the blink of an eye, no one's children and grandchildren will learn to practice good deeds and accumulate virtue, which is the right way. When you die, leaving your inheritance to your children and grandchildren is a disaster, so that for their own interests, relatives will constantly quarrel and resent each other, so much so that even after death, there is still no way to blame each other in front of this King. The worldly people only see the suffering when the retribution comes, but they never think about it Is coming here the retribution that everyone has sown in previous lives? When fate meets, the retribution is self-inflicted. Not long after, the ghost was sent to the front of the temple. A middle-aged ghost said: "When I was alive, I did business with a brother. Unexpectedly, this brother is very greedy. He wants to divide most of the family's business assets. I was illiterate during my life. He took care of outside business and communication. He knew I was illiterate so he conspired in documents to deceive me. After that, each person turned around for their own interests, and I admitted that I was also wrong about this; My family is behind his back taking advantage of the company's interests. I discussed with him that each of us give up a step to divide the company's shares and then go our separate ways. He forced me and said he would sue me in court. The legal procedures were complicated and I didn't understand anything; The situation is extremely unfavorable for me. In desperation, I looked for him and prayed that my family had a wife, son, daughter and many great-grandchildren, spare us our way of life, and leave me food to eat. But he started to mock and said, "I will make you run out of money." I was in a hasty state of mind, but on the outside I misheard my bad friend's words, saying: "You are unjust, I am unjust, so kill someone to settle the matter." Because I had been depressed about this for a long time, I became sick. For a while, I couldn't think straight, so I prepared the weapon and drove to my brother's house, planning, "If you don't give me a bite to eat, everyone will hug each other and die." When I was young, my nephew was killed by me, and my brother escaped. I was overpowered and taken to the police station. Before I died, I often felt regretful. I often cried and repented in my heart, but if I regretted the mistake I had made, it was too late. After my nephew died, he went to the underworld and denounced the King Yama, wanting to go to earth to take my life to avenge the suffering of his unjust death. After I died, the next day I was taken to hell to be punished, I had my arms and legs broken and suffered (killing someone means suffering the pain of having my arms and legs broken). I cried in hell, but I willingly volunteered to be disciplined. Fortunately, one of my relatives in the world practiced Spiritual Dharma, because of my incident, she shed tears of sadness, praying to the Bodhisattva to save my soul. The Bodhisattva took pity on me, so my case was announced to the living world. Don't leave your inheritance to your children and grandchildren, so that brothers and sisters will fight for their own interests in the future, and relatives will fight against each other. After I die, I will have to go to hell to suffer. Glory and wealth in the blink of an eye become nothing, you can't take it with you, only evil karma follows. "May the compassionate Bodhisattva, thanks to this merit, eliminate my karma from going to hell."

The King Yama sighed and said: "Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva is truly merciful. After he died, the Bodhisattva advised his ghost to understand that his karma and retribution were due to his previous life's resentment. Actually, his brother, we also investigated in the underworld, was a greedy person, did business dishonestly, and at the end of his life he will meet with evil, good will be rewarded with good, evil will be punished with evil. This ghost will be rewarded with evil. When he was alive, he attended the Buddha Dharma conference at Ma XXX of Lu Jun Hong Master Lu (the pupil's master), but he did not know how to appreciate it. If this ghost in this world was like his relative who practiced Spiritual Dharma, it would not be so foolish, it would even cause bad consequences...". Having finished speaking, the King Yama signaled the disciple to leave. The disciple took the holy scroll and left the underworld.

Answer: Temporary benefits can be achieved in the human world, but everyone will have to bear it all after going down. People who study Buddhism do not create karma or compete with others. If everyone accepts it now, they will suffer in the future. Good is rewarded with good, evil is rewarded with evil, not without reward but because the time has not yet come. In a plane crash in Indonesia, all 189 people died, while the husband of our fellow practitioner in the religion could not board the flight. Reciting sutras is very good. Are you afraid of being chased or punished in your dreams? Is it real? That's the feeling when you die, your body doesn't move but you're still suffering. Therefore, do not do evil.

– The head of the radio station opened up to answer questions (265) November 17, 2018

noi_dung:
V, AT King Yama'S PALACE HEARING THE JUDGE'S SPIRIT OF THE SEVEN DISCIPLINE'S CURSE OF THE EVIL MOUTH
五、 阎王殿听审违愿恶口的弟子亡灵

Question :November 1, 2018, today after the disciples finished worshiping Buddha and saw the sparkling luminescent statue of Guanping Bodhisattva, Guan Di Bodhisattva looked solemn and instructed the disciples to give this scroll to the underworld. This matter is related to a disciple of the Spiritual Dharma who is being escorted to hell to receive punishment.

The disciple returned home to rest, his soul was taken to the underworld to meet the King Yama. In front of the temple, there was a male sinner kneeling, his whole body covered with scars. After bowing softly, the disciple gave the scroll to King Yama and stood aside. The King Yama opened the document and read it quickly, still with a serious look on his face and said: "Currently in heaven, for those who practice Spiritual Dharma (especially disciples) to do things that break their vows, eating salty food, committing sexual misconduct, and slandering the Buddha are considered serious crimes. If people on earth do not make an effort to repent and break their vows while still alive, and even do things that slander the Dharma, then the Great Dharma Protector of the Spiritual Dharma - Guan Di Bodhisattva will call the Dharma Protector under him. At this time, the earth will severely punish the Dharma Protector under him. The government will also receive orders from heaven to pursue practitioners who violate Buddhist precepts."

The King Yama pointed at the ghost kneeling on the ground and said: "This ghost, while still alive, worshiped Master Lu Quan Hoanh, stood before Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and vowed to be vegetarian for the rest of his life, and that he and his wife should practice purity. Who would have thought that after only a few short years of studying Buddhism, he would no longer care about the precepts, break his vow to eat salty food, and even force his wife, whom he had vowed to become a pure vegetarian, to practice sexual misconduct and not study Buddhism and create bad karma. Regarding the Dharma, do you know that these things are all serious crimes? When he was sick and about to die, he did not know how to repent. When he was escorted down here, the judge even dared to blame his wife for bringing him into the Buddha's door, causing him to violate countless Buddhist precepts, and also blamed heaven and earth for being unfair.

Do you know that Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva pitied you people on earth because of your ignorance and created karma to entangle your body? Your Master, who compassionately saved you, even caused you to create the karma of speaking unfavorably about the Buddha Dharma! Before you knew how to recite the Buddha's name, you had the bad habit of committing sexual misconduct, killing, eating meat and drinking alcohol, scolding people with evil words. The evil consequences had already wrapped around your body. Your body was filled with thick black energy. Your own good results were not enough. If it weren't for your wife to help you enter the Buddha's door to recite the Buddha's name and help you know how to recite the Buddha's name, eat vegetarian and liberating living beings (life release), your life would have been gone. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva compassionately took pity on you, wrote an official letter asking the underworld to have a little mercy, so that after death you can go to hell and receive your punishment. Reciting your love while alive had Buddha's name and the merit of saving people, so he still obtained a human body and was reincarnated into a poor family. Otherwise, the kind of people in this world who deceive their teachers and forget their ancestors and are ungrateful and ungrateful will have to be reincarnated into the animal world after falling into hell, not knowing the Buddha Dharma."

The sinful soul cried on the ground, begging the King Yama: "I knew it was wrong, I was repenting every day in hell, but the punishment in hell was too harsh, I was successively sent to the tongue-cutting hell, the dung pit hell, the fire-torn hell of punishment, I really couldn't bear it, I begged Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva for mercy, asked the Dharma Protector to be merciful, asked the King Yama to have mercy on me and remember my merits while I was alive, please bring this matter to pass." I wrote this post on the internet to tell people who practice Spiritual Dharma as well as study Buddhism in general, don't commit the same crimes as me. Please be merciful to Dharma Protector Bodhisattva, help me escape from hell soon! Huhu... Please have mercy on Bodhisattva, huhuhu (the cry of the soul keeps ringing)"

The King Yama sighed, told me to return to the earthly world, a golden light surrounded my whole body, and I was brought back to the earthly world.

Answer :  The moment you spoke, I already knew who that person was. Don't take it lightly, studying Buddhism is not a joke, you must sincerely respect your teacher.

– Chief Lu explains and answers questions (266) November 20, 2018
