六、阎王殿听审诽谤正法、破佛门戒律罪灵及阻 他人弘法罪灵

Question: November 2, 2018, today after worshiping Buddha at the Avalokiteśvara Hall, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva conveyed his thoughts to his disciple: "Tonight, the Dharma Protector commanded the disciple's soul to travel to the underworld on a trip to the underworld with an official matter of the Spiritual Dharma that needed to be handled. That night, as soon as the disciple in his dream soul felt relieved, the Dharma protector took him to the underworld where the King Yama worked and the disciple handed over the scroll of documents. to the King Yama and standing aside, there were two evil spirits kneeling in front of the palace, the ghosts were so black that the disciples could not distinguish whether they were male or female. Today, the King Yama looked majestic, his eyes widened in anger and pointed at a ghost on the left: "This sinful spirit became a monk when he was still alive, his practice is not perfect, he has absolutely no understanding of heaven and earth, I have been in the underworld judging the cases of people on earth for nearly a thousand years (times). Before visiting the Underworld, the King Yama, in charge of Ma XXX, came from other temples and served the law for many years. Don't even dare to say nonsense that you know everything between heaven and earth. You are a monk, a monk, and have only practiced for not many years. How many things of heaven and earth do you know? Is a person with such high and arrogant tributes worthy of being a student of Buddhism? The Spiritual Dharma Door is the heavenly "True Dharma Bright Tathagata". Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva commissioned his disciples to go to Sa Ba country to propagate the Dharma and save sentient beings who have an affinity with this Dharma Door." Stage leader Lu Quan Hoanh, a disciple of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, followed in the footsteps of his wish to save sentient beings. Sentient beings in the world are confused and do not have enough wisdom and insight, but they should not destroy the Dharma of others or cut off the blessings of thousands of Buddhists. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has mercy on everyone, but the cause and effect of heaven and earth must still be left to everyone to bear. Although you have many years of practice and have studied a lot of Buddhist scriptures, the depth and breadth of Buddha's teachings and the many methods of practice in the world are difficult for people to understand. Okay, this King didn't say much, just said that you are in the presence of Buddha, why don't you keep the Buddhist precepts? Outwardly Buddha, what did he do in secret? You wear Buddhist robes but do things that defame Buddha and do immoral and illegal things. Collecting and plundering the money of believers is to suppress the laws you have broken, which are the five serious crimes. After death, you will be banished to hell and burned so that you can suffer the pain of being burned every day. It is also your greed that has drawn the fire of these karma. This King recites your love while still alive, has the merit and virtue of reciting sutras, waits for his karma to be completely eliminated, and is still reincarnated as a human. The King Yama then pointed to a sinful spirit on the right side: "When you were alive, you had a colleague who practiced the Spiritual Dharma. If you didn't know the precepts, the dharma did not say anything, and were ignorant and created verbal karma that hindered people in the Buddhist sect from spreading the Dharma. Do you know that you also have accumulated karma? This sinful spirit does not practice good deeds while living, drinking alcohol and gambling. You die after a car accident and are immediately taken to hell to be cremated, thinking that when you were alive, you had a kind heart and often helped people, but because of ignorance you committed a crime, so after leaving prison you will be reincarnated as a human. The official scroll in my hand is a document from the heavens because Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva took pity on you, so he sent his disciples under his command to give it to the underworld so that our underworld will treat it leniently, so that the disciples can listen to the judge and announce this matter to the earthly world so that sentient beings can be alert, do not create verbal karma based on this merit to eliminate your karma, and soon be released from prison." Saying this, the King Yama let the electron return to the earthly world under the escort of the golden light, to return to the earthly world on its own. After waking up, the disciple sighed deeply at this scene. The underworld is extremely strict towards monks who slander the Buddha Dharma, not as polite as with other sinners who still have the opportunity to ask for forgiveness and ask for a reduction in their sins. Through this incident, I could not help but feel the great compassion of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and have a heart to respect Bodhisattva. He is indeed very compassionate. The disciple feels ashamed that he has not practiced well, and still ignores the small things in the world. airy.

– Head of the station Lu opened the letter to answer questions (266). November 20, 2018

VII, AT King Yama'S PALACE, I HEARED THE CRIMINAL JUDGE USING SPIRITUAL MAGIC TO CAUSE CAUSE AND EFFECT DISORDERS OF THE HUMAN WORLD
七、 阎王殿听审用神通邪术乱动世人因果之罪灵

Question:On November 3, 2018, after the disciples worshiped Buddha and chanted sutras at the Guanyin Hall, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva instructed his disciples to invite you down to the underworld tonight to listen to the trial: "The guilty souls on trial today practiced wrongly in their past lives, in the earthly world, they took advantage of their supernatural powers to practice to see cause and effect for others, to change their destiny (those are the spiritual people that Master often mentioned), causing disturbances to cause and effect in the world. The earthly world is wanted by the underworld. This trip to the underworld will be dangerous, so when your soul goes down, I will use golden light to cover your soul so that it will not be harmed in the earthly world. It has been practicing evil magic for a while

That night before falling asleep, the disciple's soul lightened, golden rays of light surrounded the disciple, taking him down to the Hell King's workplace in the underworld. Today, the gatekeepers at the Palace of King Yama are extremely strict. Many large, fierce demons are dispatched from other palaces to guard here. The King Yama looked full of anger, glaring at the guilty spirit being pressed on the ground. This sinful spirit is different from other spirits, quite tall, about one and a half times taller than a normal person (when he was alive, he practiced evil magic, so his spirit body was taller than a normal person, his body was pitch black) and was controlled by two ghosts and pressed down hard to the ground (the devil pressed this sinful spirit 4-5 times higher than the spirit body of a normal person). The King Yama told his disciples that when he sent a ghost to hunt down this ghost, the ghost used his magical powers to fight the ghost. The process of hunting was extremely difficult.

A moment later, the King Yama shouted at the sinful spirit: "When you were still alive, you did not understand the cause and effect of Buddha Dharma, your mental techniques were unrighteous, you watched stories for others to mess up the cause and effect of people in the world, you used superstitious doctrines to chase away demons on behalf of others, and you even accepted money offerings from believers. Do you know that these things are a big taboo in the underworld! There are people in this world whose sins are inherently harsh, their life span has not yet ended, but their bodies and careers have shown signs of decline and failure. You take advantage of evil magical powers, change people's lives, and secretly look at the fate and consequences of the underworld. I order the devil to hunt you down, but you use supernatural powers to fight against people who have committed great crimes. You use your magical powers to help them, and now there is nothing left to ask for, and you are condemned to hell."

Afterwards, the guilty spirit was dragged away, his face full of indignation, that ferocious expression made the disciple standing next to him still scared when he saw it, fortunately the disciple was surrounded by golden light. The King Yama told his disciples: "Those who practice the Spiritual Dharma in the present world must remember carefully that cause and effect are self-inflicted. Those who practice the Spiritual Dharma, if, after practicing the Buddha Dharma, they still look at appearances, see cause and effect, touch the destiny, receive money from people in the world, the underworld will especially hate you. Today, I will let you go down to hear the trial, I hope you will return to earth and tell the people who practice the Spiritual Dharma if they do not change their behavior. Hey, if you don't follow Master Lu Quan Hoang's teachings, this is the place where they will have to go in the future. Don't joke with me, King Yama, heaven has heavenly laws, earth has earthly laws. Your Master accepts Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara's will to see the totems of cause and effect, so that you mortals will understand that good will be rewarded with good, evil will be rewarded with evil, practice the Buddha's Way to gain wisdom for your soul Master, the principles of cause and effect in heaven and earth are all there

After speaking, the disciple was brought back to the living world by golden light.

Answer: This person has gone to hell many times, many times, I have seen it for her, this is the truth. You must practice well. This tells you about cause and effect. When you cultivate your mind and study Buddhism, will your prayers be answered? If you don't worry about cultivating and studying, when the retribution comes, will you feel the response? As long as it is a matter of inspiration, the good and bad sides will definitely be inspired.

– Head of the station Lu opened the door to answer questions (266) November 20, 2018

noi_dung:
VIII, AT King Yama'S PALACE, I HEAR THE JUDGE CLAIMS THE CRIME OF INVOLVEMENT AND IGNORANCE THAT CREATES THE CAREER OF CLAIMING THE BUDDHA
八、 阎王殿听审敛财和无明谤佛造口业的罪灵

Question :November 5, 2018, today the disciple was invited by an official of the Dia Phu to listen to the trial process of two guilty spirits. The King Yama hopes that he will write this story down to tell the world: "Do not do evil things, do not say evil words, if you ignorantly commit the crime of defaming Buddhism, the Dia Phu will still severely punish and not forgive. People who study Buddhism must not consider Buddhist precepts as a joke, for that withholding wealth is a small matter, only after death will it be too late to repent. Cause and effect in heaven and earth, the Buddhist precepts are all in the cases of reading the Dotang and of your Master, you disciples who are still alive should understand it carefully"

Today, two sinners were escorted from hell to kneel in front of the palace. The King Yama pointed to the sinners who were kneeling backwards and asked the sinners to honestly confess their sins. The sinful spirit opened his mouth and said: "I was originally a disciple of the Spiritual Dharma, but I didn't practice Buddhism deeply. Studying Buddhism is just an external practice. I don't belong to this XXX region. My hometown is YYY country. After death, I fell into the great hell of suffering (before I traveled to the underworld, the King Yama told me that the great hell punishes all sinful souls from all over the world) screaming day and night, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, please save me, now. In the XXX region, I met a disciple traveling to the underworld with a scene from hell and wrote it down to tell the people of the world about the crimes related to withholding wealth and slandering the Buddha. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva descended to sainthood only for the underworld to send me down to confess my crime (because this sinful soul practices the Spiritual Dharma, is under the management of the Dharma Protector Bodhisattva of the Spiritual Dharma, the underworld is in charge of enforcing the law and punishing it), please Buddhas, Bodhisattvas and Bodhisattva Emperors have mercy on me so I can use this merit to Eliminate harsh sins, warn Spiritual Dharma disciples of the retribution of cruel sins. Don't think that when you do small evil deeds, cruel sins are accumulated.

When I was alive, I offered my store's products to Buddhists and followers of the Spiritual Dharma. I secretly promoted them to Buddhists. Before everyone's gathering, I secretly gave my business card and Wechat contact number. I often talked to Buddhists because I wanted to do business. When I was alive, I did not feel unstable. My brothers in the Dharma sect sent Master's instructions to me, reminding me that this was wasting money, making the bodies of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas bleed, and relying on the Dharma to make money. I don't think so, I feel like they're making a big deal out of something small. Is it that big of a reward for just earning these few silver coins? I also sell to outsiders. Why is it so serious? Does Bodhisattva not protect my health and career? I understood Buddhism in a one-sided way, disregarding Master's advice. Bodhisattva protected my cancer, but I betrayed Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara's saving grace, and did not make the effort to learn Buddha, chant sutras, propagate the Dharma to help people, did not fulfill the duty of a disciple, also said incorrect words about the brothers in the Dharma Gate,  did not listen to advice. I was wrong, I was wrong, after I died I realized I was wrong! Over a period of several years, I forgot about small causes and large effects. The underworld recorded my crimes, first of all causing me to continuously encounter bad luck, the store's business plummeted, and the cancer from before recurred in the late stages and metastasized everywhere. I went to ask for Bodhisattva's protection again, but I was not sincere in repentance. I only focused on asking Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara to help me recover from my illness. I knew Bodhisattva was the most compassionate and would definitely forgive me. I was so foolish! The King Yama told me that if I didn't sincerely repent, even Dharma Protector Bodhisattva wouldn't be able to protect me. After death, the underworld judges and falls into the burning hell. It is so painful, the whole body is burned by fire, and even if you scream in hell, no one will save you! My friend, please save me, I beg Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara for mercy, on my behalf I beg Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara and the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, I was wrong, I have truly repented. Don't be like me, think it's okay, only after falling into hell will you know suffering... Hu hu hu... (the incessant screams of the sinful souls).

I stood to the side, speechless. The King Yama let out a sigh and said to the sinful spirit: "Your karma has taken shape. No matter how much you beg anyone, it will be in vain. Bodhisattva will not change the cause and effect. Now Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva is compassionate towards you and remembers the merit and virtue of propagating the Dharma to save people while you were alive (although the plot was dishonest, it was done with a purpose), so he intentionally sent the spirit body to have his disciples return to the earthly world to write it down, so that those who practice the Spiritual Dharma can take it as a precept and not be Bodhisattva's body." Slapping and bleeding, not being able to donate money. Using this merit to alleviate your sins is already very compassionate." A moment later, the King Yama ordered the devil to bring the sinful spirit to the sinful spirit's home country, so that the underworld there would deal with it, because this sinful spirit did not belong to the XXX region. The King Yama will write an official dispatch to the underworld in country YYY, hoping that they will be a little more lenient and can use this little merit to reduce the time of their sentence a little.

Not long after, the King Yama summoned a ghost to bring another sinful spirit to the front of the palace. He pointed at the sinful spirit and said: "You in this world do not understand that Buddhism is one thing, use your personal views to distort the Buddhist ashram, and go everywhere creating karma for the Spiritual Dharma. You are the person in charge of the Taoist temple. When you were alive, you did good deeds and accumulated virtue, were filial to your parents, worked hard and loved to help others, this King highly praised. But why?" Why do you say that your relative is not good at practicing the Spiritual Dharma, that the relationship between that person and that person is a very distant relative, and they have no intention of taking you into the Dharma Gate, they just followed Master Lu Quan Hoang Master Lu's footsteps to study the Dharma, strictly follow the Buddhist precepts, practice at home, or save people in your heavenly ashram knowing that you are just a mortal in the world who does not understand the true meaning The truth of Buddha Dharma, you cannot see with your own eyes the reality of living beings in the dharma world, nor understand the law of cause and effect. Before you happened, many dreams reminded you of the consequences of your actions. You, the mortal, do not know when you wake up. Do you know that the true person is also helpless? Every religion has goodness as its basis. Sigh, even though this King pitied you for creating karma, you still have to pay for your karma Yes, I have a scroll from the True Man in your heavenly ashram, writing your good deeds and merits while alive on your behalf, asking to use your merits while alive to receive amnesty during your sentence, so that you can get out of hell, and in a little while you will follow your own destiny to be reincarnated. Seeing that your wife and children are in this pitiful, orphaned world, this King will write an official dispatch, so that every month when a Heavenly Mandarin comes to the underworld, he will convey the word to the True Man in the ashram where you studied while still alive. alive, may He be merciful to your living relatives and send someone to save and help them.

Okay, okay, go back down, don't thank me, go thank the True Man in your Dharma Place, as well as the good karma you have created."

After speaking, the ghost ordered the guilty spirit to be dragged away, and the disciple's soul was brought back to the earthly world by the golden light.

Answer: It's really pitiful, only to know it after falling down. All have first and last names. Many people who practice are truly pitiful when they are alive, pretending to try very hard and it's useless. Everything in heaven and earth is clearly understood, so we must practice truly. The Taoists said we were not good so we were dragged down. I tell you again and again, cultivate yourself, don't say that others are not good. In , we teach you not to say bad things about other Dharmas, but to practice your own well. Although he practiced Taoism so well, he was still dragged down to become a sinner and reincarnated as a human, who could have gone to heaven. So don't talk nonsense.

Chief Lu opened the door to answer questions (267). November 23, 2018

Question :  On November 7, 2018, in the dream, the disciple's soul consciousness was carried by many streams of golden light to Guan Di Palace, flying through a very large, sparkling celestial gate, to a magnificent palace, the clouds in the sky were rainbow-colored, extremely beautiful. In front of the palace gate, there is a giant Dharma Protector standing guard, about 3 or 4 floors high, wearing armor, sparkling with light. The disciples stand in front of the palace, facing the Dharma Protector, clasping their hands and worshiping (disciples do not understand the etiquette in heaven, only know how to clasp their hands towards the Dharma Protector), the Dharma Protector told them to wait a moment and wait for the announcement. Not long after, the Dharma Protector signaled that his disciples could enter the temple to pay their respects to Guan Di Bodhisattva.

In the Guan Di Palace (in the sky it really is exactly like what Master said, the heavenly beings are flying back and forth), Guan Di Bodhisattva, Chau Xuong Bodhisattva, and Guan Binh Bodhisattva are in the palace waiting for disciples, they are extremely tall. In front of the disciples, it seemed as small as a grain of rice. The 3 Dharma Protector Bodhisattvas are identical to the Bodhisattva statues we are worshiping at Guanyin Hall, only the Bodhisattvas are wearing armor and their whole bodies are sparkling with light. The disciples stood in front of Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara's palace waiting for Bodhisattva to give instructions. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva sighed and said: "You disciples in the human world, before sharing the teachings with the ideas of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, it is best to send them to the Oriental Radio secretariat for verification first. Your disciples do not have the wisdom eye like Master, they are still human beings in the flesh, there are people who still have ghosts wrapped around their bodies. Do you know that there are many times when those ideas are not the thoughts of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas? conveyed to disciples, if you carelessly share it and cause misunderstandings with sentient beings, you will have bad karma. Ideas about scenes related to hell and holy realms, it is best to send them to Dai Dong Phuong for verification. There are scenes of hell that are imagined by people. Do you know that if you keep doing that, your path of practice will go astray, if the Buddhas do not follow your body, demons will come and harass you If someone can achieve mindfulness in the present, how can the Buddha always follow his body to explain?

The disciple kept it in his heart, because he understood that Guan Di Bodhisattva was also reminding the disciple to be careful of the ideas he received. Having finished speaking, the Bodhisattva Emperor ordered the Bodhisattva Dharma Protector to take the disciple's soul to the underworld. Today, the King Yama is judging a disciple who is still in the world violating the precepts of sexual misconduct and wants the disciple to come down and hear the trial.

In front of the Palace of King Yama, the disciples as usual stood aside to listen to the trial. Today, a female spirit kneels in front of the King's Palace. The King Yama looked solemn and sighed and said: "You Buddhist disciples are still in the world practicing Spiritual Dharma, why don't you pay attention to your thoughts at all times and places? An evil thought that arises is already a sin. Not to mention committing sexual misconduct, are you worthy of your Master Lu Quan Hoang Master Lu?"

The King Yama told his son: "This female soul is not a ghost because her lifespan has not yet come, because she violated the Buddhist precepts and had an extremely deep relationship with a married man. The Dharma Protector Bodhisattva of the Spiritual Dharma School wrote a holy edict to the underworld and escorted her soul down for trial."

A moment later, the King Yama said again: "Now I say that you will fall into hell and the pit of punishment. Tomorrow in the human world, your soul will be released to the world. If you still do not know how to repent and continue to make mistakes, my underworld will record your deeds day and night. Don't wait until you die and fall into the underworld to cry in front of my palace. The man who is interacting with you is not a kind person, the underworld will also record him. Even though It's your fate in your previous life, but you can't help but know how to control your own emotional desires like that. Obviously, you know you're wrong and still continue to be confused. When the time comes, who will be in hell? After your soul returns to the earthly world, when you wake up in the morning, your mouth will be extremely stinky (because the fecal water from the hell pit is very stinky), your mood will be gloomy and lifeless, and your spirit will be depressed. These are the feelings you feel after coming out of the hell pit. If you still make mistakes when you return to this world, then you will have to bear this evil consequence yourself."

Then the King Yama called the devil to send the transgressed female spirit body down to the Dung Pit Hell. "As long as a person who practices Spiritual Dharma is still alive and commits sexual misconduct, that is knowing the Dharma and still breaking the law. The Bodhisattva Dharma Protectors of the Spiritual Dharma punish this very severely. Anyone who has committed a mistake, broken their vows, or created the karma of sexual misconduct, not only must recite the Buddha's Great Repentance Sutra 108 times, but while still in the world, write a repentance text to warn living beings and take it as a precept, there is nothing to fear. We will lose face, and when we die and go down to meet the King Yama, it will be too late to repent."

When the King Yama signaled that his disciples could return to the earthly world, his soul was brought back to the earthly world by golden light

Answer: It's really shocking, when you have nightmares, being chased by people, being beaten by people, falling from high places, these things are all being dragged to hell. She was dragged down to the Dung Pit Hell. When she woke up, her mouth would stink, her whole body would stink, and she would be in a gloomy mood. Many people who suffer from this situation still feel scared after waking up. In fact, they have been dragged down, so they absolutely must not commit sexual misconduct. Children, you must listen to Master. Don't wait until you are dragged down to feel sorry for yourself. There is no time left. Master cannot save you. That's why every day Master tells you to be "right". Don't take it lightly. Now that you are learning the Spiritual Dharma, shouldn't Master bless you? One day as a teacher, Master will definitely bless you, that's why I have to bear so much. Don't play around anymore, life is not something to be played with.

– The head of the radio station opened up to answer questions (267) November 23, 2018

Question :November 8, 2018, that night when I fell asleep, my soul was light and light, carried up to the sky by golden light, flying through the heavenly gate to the front of Guan Di's palace. After being informed, the disciples went in to see Guan Di Bodhisattva. The disciple saw an extremely large Buddha Bodhisattva, with an extremely solemn appearance. Guan Di Bodhisattva introduced it to the disciple, saying that this was one of the 88 revered Buddhas in the «Great Buddha Repentance Ceremony» - Namo Victorious Fighting Buddha. The disciples were extremely surprised, because he was different from the plays that take place in our human world, he had all the solemn Buddha appearance of a great man, extremely compassionate.

Fighting Victory Buddha explained to his disciples the following: "I heard that there was a disciple under the seat of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva who was traveling in the underworld, and saw and heard the scenes of hell to tell the world, so I deliberately went to the Quan Di Palace first to meet you. My friend, remember that on the path of practice, you must be like walking on thin ice, slanderous words should not be taken to heart, demons come from the heart. Your Master has gone through countless hardships, bringing Buddha. Such good Dharma has come to the human world, you should know how to appreciate it. I observe that many disciples of Spiritual Dharma, most of them are sincere and have true faith and mindfulness. But you must remember that supernatural powers are only a side part of the path of practice. Do not pursue them too much. Once demon thoughts appear, you will not be able to maintain yourself and will lead you to enter the path of evil This is what you should do. Buddha Dharma is pure and wonderful, your disciples in this world are still weak in virtue, slowly comprehend the truth in the «White Talk of Buddha Dharma», all the profound essence of Buddha Dharma is in it,  when you practice together in «White Talk of Buddha Dharma», the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas in heaven will bless you and help you be wise today Please return quickly.”

After speaking, the disciple was taken to the underworld by the golden light. There was a sinful spirit kneeling in front of the Palace of King Yama. The King Yama's face today was full of indignation. When this criminal was dragged down to trial, his face was unconvinced, opposing the King Yama. The devil next to him held a sign to hit him in the mouth before he finally shut up.

The King Yama scolded the sinful spirit: "People of the world think they are smart, but only have a half-hearted understanding of the Sutra Pitaka, the Buddha Dharma, the things in heaven and earth. You do not practice the Buddha Dharma, do not keep the five good and ten precepts, only know about name and form and power, use the superficial things you know to explain the Buddha Dharma, write articles, and broadcast false videos everywhere saying that Spiritual Dharma is an evil cult, ruining the life of the practitioner. (The King Yama said this and opened the screen next to him. Suddenly, on the screen, a scene of this criminal being alive used Facebook to create karma about the Spiritual Dharma, the access and sharing rates were very high.) The Buddha has mercy on you for being ignorant and stupid, so you don't fall into the Hell of No Interruption, but for the crimes you committed in the human world, this king will judge each one.

According to the sound law, I say you should enter :

– Shit Pit Hell (this sinful spirit, when alive, was married, but liked to go to nightclubs, drink alcohol outside, and have sex with many women)
– Burning Hell (this sinful spirit, when alive, borrowed the name of a charity religious ashram to save money, embezzled money from believers, did illegal business, bribery, and smuggling)
– Tongue-Cutting Hell (This sinful spirit, when alive, liked to attack and insult people and things not pleasing to the eye, even using harsh words to scold competitors online, brutal temper)

Longevity!!! No tolerance. Having finished speaking, the devil sent the guilty soul to hell to be punished. A moment later, the King Yama signaled that the disciple could return to the earthly world. The disciple was escorted back to the earthly world by golden light. After waking up, it was already after 5 am

Answer: Learning Buddhism is not for others to see, Bodhisattvas in heaven all know it, ghosts in the underworld also know it, even if you have the Master's mark, it is of no use. Make an effort to really practice, cultivate yourself and be satisfied. Whoever eats will be full. When your stomach is hungry, your mother says: "Son, let me eat for you", can you be full? Cultivate your mind and meditate well and you will achieve it. 3 inches above the head there is a spirit, cannot do bad things, strive to study Buddha, cultivate the mind, and protect the Spiritual Dharma. The Spiritual Dharma is so good, loves the country and the people, obeys the law.

– The head of the radio station opened up to answer questions (267) November 23, 2018

Question :On November 9, 2018, that night after chanting the sutras, the disciple fell asleep, his soul was light and lifted up into the sky, flying through many heavenly gates (each heavenly gate will connect to different levels of heaven, the heavenly worlds are complexly overlapping. Last time my soul traveled to the heavenly world, if it weren't for the Bodhisattva's golden light to guide the way, the disciple definitely wouldn't have been able to fly to the Quan Quan palace. Sole). While the disciples are distracted, they look at the different heavenly gates on each level of heaven (each heavenly gate will be guarded by Dharma Protector Gods belonging to their ashram, each Dharma Guardian God's appearance is different). Then the golden light disappeared.

The disciple landed in front of an unknown gate to heaven. In front of the gate were two disciples guarding it. The disciple did not know the way in the sky (because when the golden light disappeared, he lost his way), so he asked the disciple standing guard: "What is the way to the Quang De Palace?" The pupil chuckled: "I'll tell you, but you have to answer this one question of mine." I thought for a moment, then nodded. The child asked me: "What is the blackest thing in the human world?", I answered: "The blackest thing is the human heart.". The child smiled and replied: "Aren't the black rocks in Hell the blackest thing? Why is it the human heart?", I replied: "The black rocks in hell are indeed very black, but it's because people's hearts are so dark that they get lost in Hell and look to see that dark thing." The child smiled and took the child into the gate.

Inside the gate is a place very similar to the palace of the Taoist ashram in the human world, extremely large, sparkling and luminescent. I entered the palace grounds, inside there was a Bodhisattva, his appearance was solemn and beautiful. I walked over and asked: "Please tell me how to get to Guan Di Palace. I got lost." Bodhisattva said: "This place of mine has a road leading to Guan Di Palace. If your child can answer this question of mine, I will take you there." I was stunned, then nodded. Bodhisattva asked me: "Which is important, spiritual body and physical body?", I answered: "Both are important". The Bodhisattva smiled and said: "I am a student of Buddhism, why am I greedy for life and afraid of death, and do I value this mortal body? I replied: "My Master taught us to practice with hypocrisy. In the human world, of course the physical body is important." Bodhisattva smiled and said, "Follow me, I will take you to Guan Di's palace." My heart still breathed a sigh of relief,  afraid of answering something incorrectly. In heaven, getting lost is really difficult. In the human world, I am inherently blind.

A while later, the disciple arrived at Guan Di's palace.  after being informed, the disciple flew into the palace. Inside the hall, Guan Di Bodhisattva sat in the middle position. I in turn clasped my hands and bowed to the Bodhisattvas and then obediently stood aside.

Samantabhadra Bodhisattva taught his disciples: "People who study Buddhism in this world must take their vows seriously. All Buddhas and Bodhisattvas from ancient times to the present have all relied on practicing the Buddha's Way to perfect the Buddha's Way."

Manjushri Bodhisattva continued: "People who study Buddhism cannot benefit themselves, only worry about their own interests, that is not the Mahayana. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has accomplished the Buddha Way for countless eons until now, and has always used his Bodhisattva body to manifest the salvation and liberation of countless sentient beings. Now when he meets the Dharma of people who have come to earth, he is slandered everywhere by the world, but he does not hold grudges and sees all living beings as his children. Buddhists in this world, please try to help. Help Master Lu Quan Hoang Master Lu, help people achieve generous propaganda, and go together to the Four Noble Paths.

Buddha said: "Buddhism is as deep and wide as the ocean, between the Dharma Doors are like the gates of heaven that you see. They are created from different vows, born to save sentient beings and save suffering sentient beings. The Buddha Way is inherently one, people in the world should not use their own views to slander other people's Dharma Doors, this is the five against the four grave sins. This trip to Hell is due to Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva's compassion for those still living. Because of your ignorance, you create karma, so I especially want to announce it to the world. Tonight, the underworld wants you to hear the judgment of the sinners who are being punished in the Unending Hell, please go quickly." Having finished speaking, the disciple's soul was brought back to earth by the Bodhisattva.

November 10, 2018, in a dream at night while sleeping, the Guardian Angel took him to the underworld. A spirit disciple was kneeling in front of the Palace of King Yama, his entire body was pitch black. The King Yama told his son that, when he was born, this ghost was a disciple of Lu Quan Hoang Master Lu. Before he died, he had regressed and not practiced. He also created negative karma about the Dharma, going against his great vow (in Dia Phu, it is considered a crime of lying, because it is deceiving Buddha and Bodhisattva). After having problems with his body, he returned to ask Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva for salvation, but it was too late, because he did not sincerely repent. The King Yama told his disciples: "There are some souls in the animal world who have endured all the tribulation and can be reincarnated into the human world. Normally, if the beings in the animal world want to be reincarnated, they must also look at the causes and conditions of the beings in this animal world. Some have a long period of tribulation, but some have a shorter time (based on the big and small sins that the soul has committed while still a human, before being reincarnated into the animal world). Normally, the larger the animal's spirit body (buffalo, dog, lion, tiger, monkey, etc.), the higher the chance of being reincarnated into the human world, so if a living person kills these large animals, the sin will be great. tieu_de: Afterword: Introduction to Master Lu Junhong (后记)
tom_tat: Radio Director Lu Quan Hoanh currently holds the position of Chairman of the Australian Chinese Buddhist Association, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Australian Oriental Media Buddhist Dharma Propagation Charity Agency, Chairman of the Broadcasting, Television, Press and Media Group...
noi_dung:
Chief Lu Quan Hoanh currently holds the position of Chairman of the Australian Chinese Buddhist Association, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Australian Oriental Media Buddhist Dharma Propagation Charity Agency, Chairman of the Australian Oriental Broadcasting Press and Media Group, Justice of the Peace of Australia, title of Datuk of Malaysia, Honorary Visiting Professor of the University of Siena (Italy), holds an Advanced Degree in Psychology in Australia; At the same time, he also holds the position of Chairman of many Chinese associations, and has been a patriotic consul in Australia for more than thirty years.

Chief Lu Quan Hoanh has studied Buddhism and Mysticism since he was young, and has been instructed by high-ranking monks and famous teachers. He used the wonderful Dharma of Buddha, took the "great supernatural powers" of Bodhisattvas to save predestined sentient beings, causing sentient beings to break free of delusion and become enlightened, through studying Buddhism, reciting sutras, and cultivating the mind to change their destiny.

For the past thirty years, Dai Dai Lu Quan Hoanh has worked tirelessly, year-round, without stopping, dedicated to spreading the essence of Buddhism in Australia and around the world, promoting the cause of charity and peaceful cultural exchange, and promoting the harmony of human souls. To date, he has nearly 10 million followers in more than 50 countries and territories worldwide.

For more than thirty years of saving sentient beings for free, Dai Dai Lu has revealed the Bach Thoai Buddha Dharma to Buddhist friends around the world, using the truth of Buddha Dharma to guide modern life, helping countless sentient beings achieve spiritual liberation. In just a few short years, His teachings were printed all over the world. From 2010 up to now, He has held more than two hundred traveling lectures globally in major cities of Australia, New Zealand, the United States (New York, Los Angeles, Boston, San Francisco), Canada (Toronto, Vancouver), Singapore, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and European countries such as England, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Denmark, Belgium... In more than 30 countries and regions, the lectures have resonated. big, helping 10 million people around the world change their destiny, family harmony, society harmony, world peace. The February 2017 Dharma conference held in Singapore with 80,000 attendees was an unprecedented event. Dai Dai Lu received a warm welcome and love from Buddhist friends around the world, and at the same time received widespread attention and coverage from the international media. Today, "Spiritual Dharma" is raising a vibrant wave of chanting sutras, studying Buddhism, and cultivating the mind all over the world.

Chief Lu himself and the Australian Oriental Media Buddhist Dharma Propagation Charity Agency led by him have donated more than 1 million dollars in charity money to relief activities for natural disasters such as floods, earthquakes, and fires around the world, as well as for the treatment of disabled children, lonely elderly people, and people with depression through major charity organizations.

Thanks to his outstanding contributions to the development of international culture of peace and charity causes, Thai Binh Than Si Lu Quan Hoanh has repeatedly received the title of World Peace Ambassador at international peace conferences held at the United Nations, the US Congress, the Museum of American Tolerance, Berlin (Germany), as well as at the World Congress of Religions in London (UK). In 2015, Mr. Lu Quan Hoanh was honored to receive an award from the US House of Representatives praising his contributions to promoting peaceful cultural exchanges around the world. In 2016, the US Congress awarded a certificate of merit to Thai Binh Than Si Lu Quan Hoanh, recognizing his great contributions over the years to the international community in spreading compassion and harmony and efforts for world peace. The West Orange city government, New Jersey, USA awarded him the Honorary Citizen of West Orange award. In Australia, thanks to his outstanding contributions and public reputation, he was awarded the title "Justice of the Peace" by the Australian Government and awarded recognition by the Australian Parliament. He was also given the honorary title of Datuk for life by the Malaysian Royal Family; became Honorary Visiting Professor at Siena University, Italy. As a world-famous overseas Vietnamese leader and quintessential Chinese, he was specially praised by the Chinese Government and included in the "2014 Yearbook of Chinese People". He attended the 12th United Nations Day of Vesak in 2015 as a special guest. In September 2015, at the invitation of the President of the United Nations General Assembly, His Holiness attended the "2015 United Nations Summit on Culture of Peace" held at the United Nations headquarters, discussing world peace with the President of the General Assembly, Secretary General Ban Ki-moon and key leaders of countries. From 2017 to 2019, His Holiness gave the keynote speech at UNESCO's "Vesak Celebration".

Chief Lu Quan Hoanh always looks back to his fatherland. Over the past decades, he has devoted himself to promoting cultural exchanges between China and Australia, propagating traditional Chinese culture and the essence of Buddhism to the world, helping sentient beings through reciting Buddhist sutras to improve their own destiny, study, work and live better, live a good life, and better serve the development of the country and society.
